title: Keyturn Guest Protection Plan: Arriving at the Protection Fee for a Trip
content:
The protection fee for a trip is charged once against the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election that carries
the cover, on the level the election stands on and for the days of cover the election carries.

The charged days are the election's covered days, never fewer than the level's minimum charge days.

The protection fee for a trip is the level's daily amount for the charged days, held at the level's floor and
then under the ceiling on the protection fee for one trip, which is 1200.00 USD, and rounded half up to the cent
only once the whole of it has been worked out.

| The level the election stands on | Daily amount | Floor for one trip | Minimum charge days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 14.00 USD | 14.00 USD | 1 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 26.00 USD | 26.00 USD | 1 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 38.00 USD | 38.00 USD | 1 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 52.00 USD | 52.00 USD | 1 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 64.00 USD | 64.00 USD | 1 |

## The order the fee is arrived at in

The charged days are settled first, being the election's covered days raised to the level's minimum charge days
where they fall below them. The level's daily amount is then taken for each of those charged days. The figure
so reached is raised to the level's floor if it stands below it, and only then held down to 1200.00 USD if it
stands above that; the whole is rounded half up to the cent at the end.

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election on Keyturn Standard Protection carrying 5 days of cover has 5 charged days, since 5 stands above
that level's minimum charge days of 1. The daily amount of 26.00 USD for 5 days gives 130.00 USD, which stands
above the floor of 26.00 USD and below 1200.00 USD, so the fee is 130.00 USD.

An election on Keyturn Business Traveler Protection carrying 30 days of cover gives 64.00 USD for 30 days,
which is 1920.00 USD; that stands above 1200.00 USD, so the fee is 1200.00 USD.

An election on Keyturn Minimum Protection carrying no days of cover has 1 charged day, that level's minimum
charge days being 1, and the daily amount of 14.00 USD for 1 day gives 14.00 USD, which is also that level's
floor.
